lead: An `nvs-fmt` case panics with "does not parse" when its fixture breaks a *semantic* rule rather than the grammar.
body: `format` refuses on any error the parse reported, and the parse reports `rule:classes/no-free-functions-or-constants` too, so a top-level `function` in a fixture reads as a syntax error in the panic. Put a fixture's code in a class's `public static function`, the shape `examples/match.nvs` already has.
